items.title: M0 Scope and policy lock
items.context: Finalize scope boundaries, non-goals, and baseline fairness rules for PINN claim control.
items.userSees: User sees: "Scope lock validated: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-pinn-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md and scope boundary/execution boundary files include explicit excluded keywords."

happy.desc: Verify scope lock and policy boundaries are explicitly documented, including explicit exclusions and stop conditions.

edge.desc: Verify excluded items remain blocked in scope checks and do not drift into allowed scope during plan design.

adversarial.desc: Verify no hidden production/Authority/PDE-correctness promises are introduced under M0 scope lock.

items.title: M1 Claim/evidence schema
items.context: Define PINN claim/evidence schema and binding/identity checks for lifecycle transitions.
items.userSees: User sees: "Plan now defines a claim/evidence schema section with explicit identity fields and deterministic BLOCK rules."

happy.desc: Verify PINN claim/evidence identity schema covers domain, config, seed, and output fields and is versioned in the plan.

edge.desc: Verify schema mismatch or missing identity fields deterministically blocks transitions.

adversarial.desc: Verify schema cannot be widened to imply PDE correctness or scientific proof.

items.title: M2 Verifier adapter pack
items.context: Add deterministic verifier adapters for PINN residual/BC/IC/baseline/reproducibility/provenance evidence.
items.userSees: User sees: "Plan now lists the verifier adapter pack with residual/BC/IC/baseline/reproducibility/provenance evidence definitions."

happy.desc: Verify the verifier adapter pack definition includes residual, BC/IC, baseline, reproducibility, and provenance adapters.

edge.desc: Verify each adapter has explicit deterministic input/output and hash binding expectations.

adversarial.desc: Verify adapter definitions cannot produce implicit pass on missing or stale evidence.

items.title: M3 Gate policy and transition engine
items.context: Implement lifecycle gate predicates and fail-closed transition behavior (advance/repair/degrade/stop).
items.userSees: User sees: "Plan now defines fail-closed transition states with explicit advance/repair/degrade/stop outcomes and reason codes."

happy.desc: Verify gate policy defines all state transitions and blocked outcomes for advance/repair/degrade/stop.

edge.desc: Verify transition rejection includes deterministic reason codes for stale/missing/mismatch conditions.

adversarial.desc: Verify no transition path bypasses evidence binding or permits unsupported upgrades.

items.title: M4 Benchmark harness
items.context: Build A1/A2/A3/A4 benchmark + B1-B15 failure injections with reproducible report artifacts.
items.userSees: User sees: "Benchmark design now enumerates fixed A1–A4 settings and B1–B15 injections with required comparison outputs."

happy.desc: Verify benchmark design fixes task/config/evaluation settings across A1–A4 and defines B1–B15 injections.

edge.desc: Verify identical baseline settings are explicit for all regimes and no arm-level leakage exists.

adversarial.desc: Verify benchmark design avoids PDE-performance claims and measures claim-admissibility controls only.

items.title: M5 Reporting and governance integration
items.context: Add explicit boundary wording and governance docs for PINN claim-admissibility support.
items.userSees: User sees: "Boundary/gov section includes Ready-to-Quote wording and explicit non-goals without PDE correctness or production claims."

happy.desc: Verify boundary and governance wording is explicit and reused consistently with existing claim semantics.

edge.desc: Verify no wording implies PDE correctness, production readiness, or unrelated domain guarantees.

adversarial.desc: Verify documentation path and wording remain bounded to future-domain extension and do not over-claim results.
